Viewer.Title: Sonar Viewer
Viewer.NoPings: No pings detected. Place tokens or walls, or raise ping intensity.
Viewer.LevelsHint: Install the Levels module for true multi-floor sonar ranges.
Viewer.BandsHint: Vertical bands show wall/light extents from Levels or Wall Height ranges.

HyperGrid.Dimensions: 20 × 20 × 20 spatial cubes · 20 time states · 5 ft per cube

Hub.Title: Sonar GM Hub
Hub.FacingHint: Facing angle in degrees (0 = up/north, clockwise)
Hub.RateHint: Seconds between pings — 0 follows the global frequency
Hub.BeatHint: Heartbeat timer: seconds until this object's next sonar ping
Hub.ToneHint: Feedback signature: return weight and blink cadence
Hub.BulkVertsHint: One empty box = one-sided range; both empty = infinite. Applied to every checked kind.
Hub.SettingsNote: Changes to these sonar settings apply world-wide.

Settings.Title: Sonar settings
Settings.PingDurationHint: Seconds a ping takes to reach the scene edge.
Settings.MaxRingsHint: Maximum simultaneous ring sprites per emitter.
Settings.DbPerIntensityHint: Debug: gain of one intensity point, kept for future audio.
Settings.EchoAttenuationHint: 0 (none) to 1 (heavy). Lower values make far objects glow longer.
Settings.ShowRingSpritesHint: Draw expanding rings on the game canvas. Requires re-render.
Settings.WaveEnabledHint: Pings become expanding wavefronts with interference and lattice rail excitation.
Settings.WaveReflectionsHint: Wavefronts bounce off walls as weakened echo fronts.
Settings.WaveSpeedHint: How fast wavefronts travel across the scene.
Settings.MemoryEnabledHint: Every coordinate remembers its sonar history (pings, traces, echo returns).
Settings.MemoryRetentionHint: How long memory stays warm before fading — 0 keeps it forever.
Settings.TrackToleranceHint: How closely an object's snapshot must match a track's stored image to continue it (0 = strict, 0.9 = loose).
Settings.CamEnabledHint: Include this camera in the perimeter.
Settings.CamAngleHint: Deg rotation about the Z axis (0 = +Y is up-screen).
Settings.StoreyHeightHint: Vertical height of one floor storey in grid units. With the Levels module active, floor ranges (rangeBottom/rangeTop) take precedence for ping placement.
Vertical height of one floor storey in grid units. With the Levels module active, floor ranges (rangeBottom/rangeTop) take precedence for ping placement.
Settings.CamTiltHint: 0 = straight down, 90 = level with the floor.
Settings.CamModeHint: Project pings into the camera image (reserved for 3D mode).

Errors.GmOnly: Only the GM can open the Sonar GM Hub.

Waypoint.Armed: Click the scene to deploy a waypoint

Pathway.SpacingHint: Grid units between ping points along the line

Lattice.Hint: Every gridline becomes a pathway; every same-floor crossing becomes a junction node. Hand-drawn lines are kept.
Lattice.MonitorsHint: Puts a sonar waypoint on every grid corner (per storey). Each carries a live heartbeat: it pings on its own cadence, shows its countdown in the table, and pulses in the viewer on its beat.

Quantum.CubeHint: Quantum cube — six cameras, one portal.
Quantum.OpenHint: Open the Quantum Portal — the 4D sonar viewer

Identity.AssignHint: Persistent identity id for this object. Leave empty to forge one. Every zone the object crosses keeps continuing this id — even after Forget All.
Identity.RecaptureHint: Re-capture this object's snapshot — use after a disguise, polymorph, or actor swap so its track continues under the new image
Identity.RecaptureUnidentified: Touch | This object has no identity or track to re-capture yet — it needs to cross a zone (or be assigned an id) first.
Identity.Taken: Touch | That identity id is already taken by another object.
Identity.Revoked: Touch | Identity removed. The next crossing forges a fresh id.

Groups.MemberHint: Marching with a group — one shared contact
Groups.DissolveHint: Dissolve this group into individual tracks
Groups.TimelineHint: Formation timeline — when tracks joined or left this group (hover an entry for the exact time)
Groups.SectionHint: Tracks moving together (matching speed and heading) share one group contact. They re-associate automatically on the next crossing.

Memory.Hint: Every coordinate remembers its sonar history: pings, surface traces, and echo returns at corner monitors — with decaying heat. Saved with the scene.

Waves.Hint: Pings become expanding wavefronts: they attenuate with distance, bounce off walls as dashed echo fronts, and interfere — bright dots where fronts reinforce, dark nulls where they cancel. Lattice rails glow with incident intensity.
